approved_translation: One who is free from pride, passion, and attachment touches the peace of the eternal.
context_summary: Krishna describes the state of liberation: when a person is free from pride, passion, and the illusion of the separate self, they attain a deep and abiding tranquility. This is the state of Brahman—pure, peaceful, and unshaken by the storms of life.
interpretation_boundaries: Depict a figure in serene meditation, free from earthly chains
Use imagery of dawn light, still water, or a mountain peak
Keep the visual ethereal and transcendent
